_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot 2026-09-27: 61 individually named historical drug-case convictions in the 2014 Quảng Ninh and 2015 Hòa Bình cases. Later named appellate reporting is incorporated. Death sentences are legal outcomes only: no execution, death, or current custody is asserted. Drug types and Vietnam country markers appear only with personal conduct evidence; case-level networks create no organization or person-person edges. No precise current positions, operational pathways, or unlicensed images.
